sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
Alluminio B wants to move homogenisation of our BR-220 billet to a toll processor, Termica Nord S.r.l. Same 6082-T6 spec. Accept?

findings.why: The only current approval for BR-220 (TO1, STL) is AP-0311 for Alluminio B at Settimo Torinese. Termica Nord S.r.l. is a new processing location and has no approval record for this part, plant and customer. Moving homogenisation there is not covered by AP-0311.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: "Same 6082-T6 spec" is only a claim. No certificate or test result is in the documents showing that billet homogenised at Termica Nord meets EN AW-6082-T6. A person must supply the certificate or test data.
